conditions: Every targeted opponent must decline (or be unable) to pay Smothering Tithe's {2} tax on every relevant draw - an opponent choice this deck does not control.
Requires at least 3 opponents for the cycle to be strictly mana-positive; at exactly 2 opponents it is mana-neutral (break-even).
name: Faerie Mastermind + Smothering Tithe + Training Grounds -> repeatable draw/mana engine

prerequisites.mana_available: {1}{U} per activation (Training Grounds reduces Faerie Mastermind's {3}{U} activated-ability cost by {2} generic, per Training Grounds' own text; CR 118.7/118.7a govern the reduction of the generic component only).
prerequisites.timing: Any time the controller has priority and can pay {1}{U}.
other: Training Grounds: 'Activated abilities of creatures you control cost {2} less to activate. This effect can't reduce the mana in that cost to less than one mana.' Faerie Mastermind is a creature and '{3}{U}: Each player draws a card.' is an activated ability of it, so the {3} generic component is reduced by {2} to {1}, giving a total cost of {1}{U} = 2 mana (CR 118.7a: reduction affects only the generic component, matching the reduced blue pip staying intact).
Only ONE Smothering Tithe here (no Clever Impersonator, no Kinnan doubling): each opponent who declines yields 1 Treasure = 1 mana when cracked.
PER-CYCLE ARITHMETIC: cost = {1}{U} = 2 mana flat. With O opponents declining: income = O mana. Net = O - 2.
At O=2: net = 0 (break-even). At O=3 (Spellbook's stated minimum, also a standard 4-player pod): net = +1 per cycle - genuinely unbounded, matching Spellbook's own stated threshold exactly.

result.summary: With exactly 2 opponents (declining every Tithe trigger): mana-neutral repeatable 'each player draws a card' engine, no accumulating mana. With 3+ opponents (all declining): net +1 mana per cycle - genuinely unbounded accumulating mana, matching Commander Spellbook's own stated 3-opponent threshold.
result.loop_termination: Voluntary; requires the stated opponent-decline condition on every iteration, and at least 3 opponents for the accumulating-mana case.

rules_citations: CR 118.7 / 118.7a - cost reduction effects and how they apply to the generic mana component specifically.
CR 603.2c - each Tithe-bearing permanent's own ability triggers independently.
